name: Roxana Monica Nagy
role: Co-Founder and Creative Technologist at Reality Check
bio:
Roxana Nagy is the Co-Founder and Creative Technologist at Reality Check, an immersive content innovation studio focusing on Apple's spatial computing technologies. She co-created The Green Spurt, a collaborative immersive escape room-style game that serves as a testing ground for shared immersive experiences, combining storytelling, co-presence, and technical innovation to showcase what is possible on Apple Vision Pro.

A pioneer in augmented reality since 2017, Roxana developed some of the industry’s first commercial implementations of Apple’s ARKit and led the Immersive Technologies practice at a global digital consultancy, working with inspiring clients such as Museum of The Future Dubai and NEOM.
With a mission to inspire others to explore the pioneering frontier of spatial computing and generative AI, Roxana shares her insights on her blog roxana-nagy.com and on social media as @coderox. She co-hosts weekly Office Hours for the Step Into Vision community, the largest global hub of visionOS resources, and was instrumental in building communities such as Women in Tech Dubai.
